verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Snyk Open Source can scan for license compliance against known licenses (snyk-docs-20), and the plans page references generic 'Policy management' (snyk-docs-32), supporting license policy enforcement. However, evidence lacks detail on configuring custom license policies, blocking builds on license violations, or CI/CD gating specifics for license issues. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of license policy configuration/enforcement rules, CI gating examples, and independent confirmation of license-scan accuracy.
